whatIs: MagicPattern is a toolbox of more than 30 tools for creating patterns, gradients, blobs, SVG waves, doodle-style backgrounds and color palettes. You export as an image (JPG, PNG, SVG, GIF) or as SVG and CSS code, depending on the tool.
It's a good fit for quickly producing backgrounds and decorative shapes for landing pages, social media or branding without design skills.
uses: Creating a CSS pattern for a section background.
Generating an SVG wave to separate sections of a landing page.
Building a Tailwind color palette from a base color.
caveats: Commercial use is listed among the benefits of the paid plans and reselling graphics is only allowed on Pro; check the terms before using a graphic in client work.
Basic costs $15 a month or $120 a year and saves up to 100 graphics; Pro costs $30 a month or $240 a year, with no such limit.
The available exports depend on the tool; confirm that the one you need delivers the format you're after.
pricingNote: There's a free plan; Basic from $10/month and Pro from $20/month when billed annually, plus 3- or 6-month passes.
idealFor: People who need many kinds of backgrounds and decorative shapes in one place.
